responsibility: Declares the middle-end regimplification interface for forcing expressions into valid GIMPLE operands after the main lowering phase. It defines the gimple_predicate callback type and exposes the force_gimple_operand, force_gimple_operand_gsi, and gimple_regimplify_operands entry points used by transformations that need to materialize temporaries or repair statement operands in-place.
same_name_distinction: Header for the middle-end regimplification helpers that force or repair valid GIMPLE operands after main lowering; unlike gcc/gimplify-me.cc it has only declarations, and unlike gcc/gimplify.h it covers the narrower post-pass repair API rather than the full gimplifier interface.
